purpose: Unchanged biological read content from genuine SEQC2 HCC1395/HCC1395BL matched cell lines, with explicit regional coordinate rebasing, for native/patched-native/WebAssembly somatic caller parity; not an unbiased clinical accuracy benchmark.

WGS_NS_T_1.bwa.dedup.bai.purpose: Upstream published BAM MD5 and original indexes documenting byte-range selection

WGS_NS_N_1.bwa.dedup.bai.purpose: Upstream published BAM MD5 and original indexes documenting byte-range selection

WGS.md5.purpose: Upstream published BAM MD5 and original indexes documenting byte-range selection

pysam-0.23.3.tar.gz.purpose: Pinned optional regeneration library source; installed pysam 0.23.3 is required for exact BAM/index writing.

tumor.fullBamMD5Status: Published NCBI WGS.md5 checksum; the full 67/80 GB BAM was not downloaded or rehashed. Every retrieved byte range is independently SHA256-pinned.

normal.fullBamMD5Status: Published NCBI WGS.md5 checksum; the full 67/80 GB BAM was not downloaded or rehashed. Every retrieved byte range is independently SHA256-pinned.

hcc1395.name: SEQC2 HCC1395 / HCC1395BL real matched tumour-normal windows
hcc1395.readSource: Real biological WGS paired reads from NCBI SEQC2 matched tumour HCC1395 and normal HCC1395BL. Complete primary pairs were selected and coordinates rebased consistently; no synthetic or spiked variants or reads.
hcc1395.ploidyNote: Ploidy 2 is a caller model/default, not an assertion of diploid tumour copy number.
hcc1395.truthCaveat: SEQC2 truth aggregates many replicates. The low-frequency truth SNV chr21:21418545 has 0/51 tumour observations at MQ20/BQ20 in this NS_T_1 subset, so its absence does not establish a numerical port failure.

regeneration.determinism: Raw BGZF source ranges and headers are pinned. Final BAM preparation changes coordinates only and passes exact regeneration with pysam 0.23.3. --regenerate replaces files only after all generated SHA256 values match.

provenance.publicSourceNotes: Public research cell-line data, not a clinical patient sample. No assertion that all upstream data has the same license as this software project. Preserve upstream attribution and provider terms.
